print(f\\\"[SANDBOX ERROR] Merge failed: {err}\\\")\\n            return False\\n\\n        print(f\\\"[SANDBOX] Deleting sandbox branch {sandbox_branch}...\\\")\\n        self._git_run(f\\\"branch -d {sandbox_branch}\\\")\\n\\n        if stashed:\\n            print(\\\"[SANDBOX] Restoring stashed changes...\\\")\\n            self._git_run(\\\"stash pop\\\")\\n\\n        return True\\n\\n    def discard_sandbox(self, task_id, original_branch, stashed):\\n        sandbox_branch = f\\\"seikoclaw-sandbox-{task_id}\\\"\\n        print(f\\\"[SANDBOX] Discarding sandbox changes on {sandbox_branch}...\\\")\\n        \\n        self._git_run(\\\"reset --hard\\\")\\n        self._git_run(\\\"clean -fd\\\")\\n\\n        print(f\\\"[SANDBOX] Returning to original branch: {original_branch}\\\")\\n        rc, _, err = self._git_run(f\\\"checkout {original_branch}\\\")\\n        if rc != 0:\\n            print(f\\\"[SANDBOX ERROR] Failed to return to original branch: {err}\\\")\\n            return False\\n\\n        print(f\\\"[SANDBOX] Deleting sandbox branch {sandbox_branch}...\\\")\\n        self._git_run(f\\\"branch -D {sandbox_branch}\\\")\\n\\n        if stashed:\\n            print(\\\"[SANDBOX] Restoring stashed changes...\\\")\\n            self._git_run(\\\"stash pop\\\")\\n\\n        return True\\n\\n    def run_task(self, name, command, cwd=None):\\n        \\\"\\\"\\\"Executes a single command with usage oversight.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n        provider = \\\"google\\\" # Default for most tools here\\n        \\n        # 1. Check limits before starting\\n        limit_reached, msg = self.usage.check_limits(\\n            provider, \\n            self.limits[provider][\\\"tokens\\\"], \\n            self.limits[provider][\\\"requests\\\"]\\n        )\\n        \\n        if limit_reached:\\n            print(f\\\"[PAUSED] {name}: {msg}\\\")\\n            return f\\\"SKIP: {msg}\\\"\\n\\n        print(f\\\"[Executing] {name}: {command} (in {cwd or '.'})\\\")\\n        \\n        # 2. Execute\\n        try:\\n            result = subprocess.run(command, shell=True, capture_output=True, text=True, cwd=cwd)\\n            \\n            # 3. Estimate actual token usage of the output\\n            output_text = result.stdout + result.stderr\\n            actual_tokens = token_estimator.estimate_tokens(output_text)\\n            \\n            # 4. Track usage\\n            self.usage.track_usage(provider, tokens=actual_tokens, requests=1) \\n            \\n            # 5. Safety Warning: If output is very large, alert for manual summarization\\n            if actual_tokens > 10000:\\n                print(f\\\"[CRITICAL] {name} output is {actual_tokens} tokens! Consider summarizing before next task.\\\")\\n\\n            if result.returncode == 0:\\n                return f\\\"SUCCESS: {name}\\\"\\n            else:\\n                return f\\\"FAILURE: {name}\\\\nError: {result.stderr}\\\"\\n        except Exception as e:\\n            return f\\\"ERROR: {name}\\\\nException: {str(e)}\\\"\\n\\n    def execute_tablebuddy_tests(self):\\n        \\\"\\\"\\\"Orchestrates Tablebuddy Phase 11 testing.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n        print(\\\"[SeikoClaw] Starting Tablebuddy Backend...\\\")\\n        # Start server in background\\n        server = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, \\\"server.py\\\"], cwd=\\\"")\\n        import time\\n        time.sleep(3) # Wait for startup\\n        \\n        try:\\n            tasks = [\\n                {\\\"name\\\": \\\"Auth & Roles\\\", \\\"command\\\": \\\"java -cp \\\\\\\"../karate.jar;.\\\\\\\" com.intuit.karate.Main api/auth_and_roles.feature\\\"},\\n                {\\\"name\\\": \\\"Asset Management\\\", \\\"command\\\": \\\"java -cp \\\\\\\"../karate.jar;.\\\\\\\" com.intuit.karate.Main api/asset_management.feature\\\"},\\n                {\\\"name\\\": \\\"WebSocket Sync\\\", \\\"command\\\": \\\"java -cp \\\\\\\"../karate.jar;.\\\\\\\" com.intuit.karate.Main api/websocket_sync.feature\\\"},\\n                {\\\"name\\\": \\\"Network Validation\\\", \\\"command\\\": \\\"java -cp \\\\\\\"../karate.jar;.\\\\\\\" com.intuit.karate.Main api/network_validation.feature\\\"}\\n            ]\\n            self.execute_parallel(tasks, cwd=\\\"karate_e2e_tests\\\")\\n        finally:\\n            print(\\\"[SeikoClaw] Shutting down Tablebuddy Backend...\\\")\\n            server.terminate()\\n\\n    def execute_parallel(self, tasks, cwd=None):\\n        \\\"\\\"\\\"Runs multiple tasks in parallel using a thread pool.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n        print(f\\\"[SeikoClaw] Launching {len(tasks)} tasks in parallel...\\\")\\n        \\n        with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=4) as executor:\\n            fut_to_task = {executor.submit(self.run_task, t['name'], t['command'], cwd): t for t in tasks}\\n            for future in concurrent.futures.as_completed(fut_to_task):\\n                res = future.result()\\n                print(f\\\"[Completed] {res}\\\")\\n\\n    def sync_global(self):\\n        \\\"\\\"\\\"Syncs local .agents and third-party skills to global locations.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n        import shutil\\n        user_home = os.path.expanduser(\\\"~\\\")\\n        global_root = os.path.join(user_home, \\\".gemini\\\", \\\"antigravity\\\")\\n        \\n        mapping = {\\n            \\\".agents/workflows\\\": os.path.join(global_root, \\\"global_workflows\\\"),\\n            \\\".agents/skills\\\": os.path.join(global_root, \\\"global_skills\\\"),\\n            \\\".agents/modular_skills\\\": os.path.join(global_root, \\\"skills\\\")\\n        }\\n        \\n        print(\\\"[SeikoClaw] Starting Global Sync...\\\")\\n        # 1. Sync custom assets\\n        for local_dir, global_dir in mapping.items():\\n            if not os.path.exists(local_dir):\\n                continue\\n            os.makedirs(global_dir, exist_ok=True)\\n            for item in os.listdir(local_dir):\\n                s = os.path.join(local_dir, item)\\n                d = os.path.join(global_dir, item)\\n                if os.path.isdir(s):\\n                    if os.path.exists(d):\\n                        shutil.rmtree(d)\\n                    shutil.copytree(s, d)\\n                    print(f\\\"[COPIED-DIR] {item} -> {global_dir}\\\")\\n                elif os.path.isfile(s):\\n                    shutil.copy2(s, d)\\n                    print(f\\\"[COPIED-FILE] {item} -> {global_dir}\\\")\\n        \\n        # 2. Sync Third-Party Agent Skills (Preserving directory structure)\\n        tp_skills_root = \\\"third-party/agent-skills/skills\\\"\\n        global_skills_dest = os.path.join(global_root, \\\"skills\\\", \\\"third-party\\\")\\n        if os.path.exists(tp_skills_root):\\n            print(\\\"[SeikoClaw] Syncing Third-Party Skills (Modular)...\\\")\\n            os.makedirs(global_skills_dest, exist_ok=True)\\n            for skill_name in os.listdir(tp_skills_root):\\n                skill_dir = os.path.join(tp_skills_root, skill_name)\\n                if os.path.isdir(skill_dir):\\n                    dest_dir = os.path.join(global_skills_dest, skill_name)\\n                    if os.path.exists(dest_dir):\\n                        shutil.rmtree(dest_dir)\\n                    shutil.copytree(skill_dir, dest_dir)\\n                    print(f\\\"[SYNCED-DIR] {skill_name} -> {global_skills_dest}\\\")\\n\\n    def reflect_on_task(self, task_file: str):\\n        \\\"\\\"\\\"Analyzes a task file and synthesizes or evolves a skill.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n        if not os.path.exists(task_file):\\n            return \\\"Error: Task file not found.\\\"\\n\\n        with open(task_file, \\\"r\\\", encoding=\\\"utf-8\\\") as f:\\n            content = f.read()\\n\\n        if \\\"[x]\\\" not in content:\\n            return \\\"No completed tasks found to reflect upon.\\\"\\n\\n        print(f\\\"[SeikoClaw] Reflecting on completed tasks in {os.path.basename(task_file)}...\\\")\\n        \\n        # 1. Synthesis via LocalMind\\n        try:\\n            from localmind.engine import LocalMindEngine\\n            model_dir = \\\"models\\\"\\n            llm = LocalMindEngine(backend=\\\"auto\\\", model_dir=model_dir)\\n            \\n            import re\\n            skill_name_candidate = None\\n            match = re.search(r\\\"Skill:\\\\s*(.*)\\\", content)\\n            if match:\\n                skill_name_candidate = match.group(1).strip()\\n            \\n            previous_skill_text = \\\"None\\\"\\n            if skill_name_candidate:\\n                prev = self.memory.get_skill(skill_name_candidate)\\n                if prev:\\n                    previous_skill_text = str(prev)\\n            \\n            prompt = SKILL_SYNTHESIS_PROMPT.format(trajectory=content, previous_skill=previous_skill_text)\\n            skill_text = llm.generate(prompt, max_tokens=1024)\\n            \\n            if skill_text and \\\"[Mock Response]\\\" not in skill_text:\\n                # 2. Extract Skill Name and metadata\\n                name_match = re.search(r\\\"name:\\\\s*(.*)\\\", skill_text)\\n                skill_name = name_match.group(1).strip() if name_match else \\\"New Skill\\\"\\n                \\n                desc_match = re.search(r\\\"description:\\\\s*(.*)\\\", skill_text) # if we added it to YAML\\n                desc = desc_match.group(1).strip() if desc_match else \\\"Auto-learned skill\\\"\\n                \\n                # 3. Save to Openbrain (Both Memory and Dedicated Table)\\n                self.memory.save_memory(\\n                    text=skill_text,\\n                    tier=\\\"Longterm\\\",\\n                    source=\\\"SeikoClaw-Reflection\\\",\\n                    tags=f\\\"skill,auto-learned,{skill_name}\\\"\\n                )\\n                self.memory.save_skill(name=skill_name, description=desc, example=skill_text)\\n                \\n                print(f\\\"[SUCCESS] { 'Evolved' if previous_skill_text != 'None' else 'Synthesized' } skill: {skill_name}\\\")\\n                return skill_name\\n        except Exception as e:\\n            print(f\\\"[ERROR] Skill reflection failed: {e}\\\")\\n            return None\\n\\n    def sync_wiki(self, message=\\\"Auto-sync from SeikoClaw\\\"):\\n        \\\"\\\"\\\"Syncs the current project state into the Master Wiki.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n        print(\\\"[SeikoClaw] Syncing state to Master Wiki...\\\")\\n        wiki_dir = \\\"/.master_wiki\\\"\\n        if not os.path.exists(wiki_dir):\\n            print(f\\\"[ERROR] Master Wiki not found at {wiki_dir}\\\")\\n            return\\n            \\n        # 1. Read task.md for progress\\n        progress = \\\"No recent task info found.\\\"\\n        task_paths = [\\\"task.md\\\", \\\"artifact/task.md\\\"]\\n        for p in task_paths:\\n            if os.path.exists(p):\\n                with open(p, \\\"r\\\", encoding=\\\"utf-8\\\") as f:\\n                    progress = f.read()\\n                break\\n                \\n        # 2. Prepare payload for llmwiki-cli\\n        page_data = {\\n            \\\"title\\\": \\\"Latest Task Sync\\\",\\n            \\\"tags\\\": [\\\"auto-sync\\\", \\\"seikoclaw\\\"],\\n            \\\"content\\\": f\\\"## Recent Progress\\\\n\\\\n\\\\\\`\\\\\\`\\\\\\`markdown\\\\n{progress[:2000]}\\\\n\\\\\\`\\\\\\`\\\\\\`\\\"\\n        }\\n        json_input = json.dumps(page_data)\\n        \\n        # 3. Write to wiki using CLI\\n        print(\\\"[SeikoClaw] Writing to wiki via llmwiki-cli...\\\")\\n        try:\\n            proc = subprocess.Popen([\\\"wiki\\\", \\\"write\\\", \\\"wiki/synthesis/latest_sync.md\\\"], \\n                                   cwd=wiki_dir, stdin=subprocess.PIPE, \\n                                   stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True, shell=True)\\n            out, err = proc.communicate(input=json_input)\\n            if proc.returncode != 0:\\n                print(f\\\"[WARNING] Wiki write failed: {err}\\\")\\n                \\n            # 4. Auto-commit with descriptive message for rollback\\n            subprocess.run([\\\"git\\\", \\\"add\\\", \\\".\\\"], cwd=wiki_dir, shell=True)\\n            subprocess.run([\\\"git\\\", \\\"commit\\\", \\\"-m\\\", f\\\"Auto-sync: {message}\\\"], cwd=wiki_dir, shell=True)\\n            print(\\\"[SUCCESS] Master Wiki updated and committed.\\\")\\n        except Exception as e:\\n            print(f\\\"[ERROR] Failed to sync wiki: {e}\\\")\\n\\n    def manage_kanban(self, action, task_id=None, status=None, project=\\\"default\\\"):\\n        \\\"\\\"\\\"CLI helper for Kanban operations.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n        if action == \\\"list\\\":\\n            board = self.memory.get_kanban(project)\\n            print(f\\\"--- Kanban Board: {project} ---\\\")\\n            if not board:\\n                print(\\\"No tasks found.\\\")\\n            for tid, info in board.items():\\n                print(f\\\"[{info['status']}] {tid} (Updated: {info['updated_at']})\\\")\\n        elif action == \\\"update\\\" and task_id and status:\\n            self.memory.update_kanban(project, task_id, status)\\n            print(f\\\"[SUCCESS] Updated {task_id} to {status}\\\")\\n\\n    def loop_until_goal(self, goal, max_turns=5):\\n        \\\"\\\"\\\"Autonomous loop that continues until a goal is met or budget is exhausted.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n        budget = IterationBudget(max_turns=max_turns)\\n        print(f\\\"[SeikoClaw] Starting autonomous loop for goal: {goal}\\\")\\n        \\n        while not budget.is_exhausted():\\n            print(f\\\"\\\\n--- Turn {budget.current_turns + 1} ---\\\")\\n            \\n            # 1. Estimate current context\\n            # We estimate by summing up Shortterm memories + recent task info\\n            memories = self.memory.retrieve_similar(goal, n_results=20)\\n            context_text = \\\"\\\\n\\\".join([m['content'] for m in memories])\\n            current_context_tokens = token_estimator.estimate_tokens(context_text)\\n            \\n            budget.consume(tokens=0, context_tokens=current_context_tokens)\\n            print(f\\\"[STATUS] {budget}\\\")\\n            \\n            # 2. Check for early break / handoff\\n            if current_context_tokens >= (budget.context_limit * 0.9):\\n                print(f\\\"[CRITICAL] Context limit reached ({current_context_tokens} tokens).\\\")\\n                print(\\\"[ACTION] Performing auto-handoff...\\\")\\n                handoff_path = \\\"handoff.md\\\"\\n                with open(handoff_path, \\\"w\\\", encoding=\\\"utf-8\\\") as f:\\n                    f.write(f\\\"# Handoff: {goal}\\\\n\\\\nLoop paused due to context pressure.\\\\n\\\")\\n                    f.write(f\\\"Tokens: {current_context_tokens}\\\\n\\\")\\n                    f.write(f\\\"Last Action: Loop Turn {budget.current_turns}\\\\n\\\")\\n                print(f\\\"[ALERT] Handoff created at {handoff_path}. Please start a new session.\\\")\\n                break\\n\\n            # 3. Check goal (mock check)\\n            if \\\"complete\\\" in goal.lower():\\n                print(\\\"[SUCCESS] Goal detected as complete.\\\")\\n                break\\n                \\n            # 4. Memory Compression (Maintenance)\\n            if self.memory.context_engine.compress_shortterm(threshold=5):\\n                print(\\\"[MAINTENANCE] Compressed recent short-term memories into Midterm.\\\")\\n\\n            # 5. Simulate a task implementation step\\n            print(\\\"[ACTION] Implementing next step...\\\")\\n            \\n        if budget.is_exhausted() and current_context_tokens < (budget.context_limit * 0.9):\\n            print(\\\"[PAUSED] Iteration budget exhausted.\\\")\\n\\n    def generate_visual_plan(self, task_file=\\\"task.md\\\"):\\n        \\\"\\\"\\\"Generates a visual plan from a task file or master vision and serves the local bridge.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n        import re\\n        import json\\n        print(f\\\"[SeikoClaw] Generating Visual Plan from {task_file}...\\\")\\n        \\n        # 1. Resolve content\\n        content = \\\"\\\"\\n        if os.path.exists(task_file):\\n            with open(task_file, \\\"r\\\", encoding=\\\"utf-8\\\") as f:\\n                content = f.read()\\n        else:\\n            # Fallback to project_vision.md\\n            vision_path = \\\"project_vision.md\\\"\\n            if os.path.exists(vision_path):\\n                with open(vision_path, \\\"r\\\", encoding=\\\"utf-8\\\") as f:\\n                    content = f.read()\\n            else:\\n                content = \\\"No task file found.\\\"\\n\\n        # 2. Setup directory\\n        plan_dir = os.path.join(\\\".agents\\\", \\\"plans\\\", \\\"plan\\\")\\n        os.makedirs(plan_dir, exist_ok=True)\\n        \\n        # 3. Write plan.mdx\\n        mdx_content = f\\\"\\\"\\\"---\\ntitle: \\\"SeikoClaw Visual Plan\\\"\\nbrief: \\\"Visual plan generated for task planning\\\"\\nlocalOnly: true\\n---\\n\\n# SeikoClaw Task Plan\\n\\n## Task Description\\n{content}\\n\\n<Checklist id=\\\"seikoclaw-checklist\\\" items={[\\n\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n        # Convert checklist lines\\n        item_id = 1\\n        for line in content.splitlines():\\n            # Match task checklist item\\n            m = re.match(r\\\"^\\\\s*-\\\\s*\\\\[\\\\s*\\\\]\\\\s*(.*)\\\", line)\\n            if m:\\n                label = m.group(1).replace('\\\"', '\\\\\\\\\\\"').strip()\\n                mdx_content += f'  {{ id: \\\"task-{item_id}\\\", label: \\\"{label}\\\" }},\\\\n'\\n                item_id += 1\\n        \\n        mdx_content += \\\"\\\"\\\"]} />\\n\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n        \\n        plan_mdx_path = os.path.join(plan_dir, \\\"plan.mdx\\\")\\n        with open(plan_mdx_path, \\\"w\\\", encoding=\\\"utf-8\\\") as f:\\n            f.write(mdx_content)\\n        \\n        # 4. Serve the bridge\\n        npm_global_bin = \\\"/.npm-global/agent-native.cmd\\\"\\n        cmd_prefix = npm_global_bin if os.path.exists(npm_global_bin) else \\\"npx @agent-native/core\\\"\\n\\n        print(\\\"[SeikoClaw] Checking visual plan syntax...\\\")\\n        subprocess.run(f\\\"{cmd_prefix} plan local check --dir .agents/plans/plan\\\", shell=True)\\n        \\n        print(\\\"[SeikoClaw] Serving visual plan on local bridge...\\\")\\n        # Start server in background so CLI execution doesn't block permanently\\n        subprocess.Popen(f\\\"{cmd_prefix} plan local serve --dir .agents/plans/plan --kind plan --open\\\", shell=True)\\n        \\n        # Read the URL\\n        url_file = os.path.join(plan_dir, \\\".plan-url\\\")\\n        import time\\n        time.sleep(2)\\n        if os.path.exists(url_file):\\n            with open(url_file, \\\"r\\\", encoding=\\\"utf-8\\\") as f:\\n                url = f.read().strip()\\n            print(f\\\"[SUCCESS] Visual Plan served successfully!\\\\nLocal Bridge URL: {url}\\\")\\n        else:\\n            print(\\\"[INFO] Bridge starting. Open the local bridge URL from console logs.\\\")\\n\\n    def generate_visual_recap(self, task_id=\\\"current-task\\\"):\\n        \\\"\\\"\\\"Generates a visual recap from git diff and serves the local bridge.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n        import json\\n        print(f\\\"[SeikoClaw] Generating Visual Recap for task: {task_id}...\\\")\\n        \\n        # 1. Gather diff files\\n        rc, diff_stat, _ = self._git_run(\\\"diff --name-status HEAD\\\")\\n        if rc != 0 or not diff_stat:\\n            # Try last commit if working tree is clean\\n            rc, diff_stat, _ = self._git_run(\\\"diff-tree --no-commit-id --name-status -r HEAD\\\")\\n            is_last_commit = True\\n        else:\\n            is_last_commit = False\\n\\n        if not diff_stat:\\n            print(\\\"[SeikoClaw] No git changes detected. Skipping recap.\\\")\\n            return None\\n\\n        recap_dir = os.path.join(\\\".agents\\\", \\\"plans\\\", \\\"recap\\\")\\n        os.makedirs(recap_dir, exist_ok=True)\\n        \\n        file_items = []\\n        diff_blocks = \\\"\\\"\\n        diff_id = 1\\n        \\n        for line in diff_stat.splitlines():\\n            parts = line.split()\\n            if len(parts) >= 2:\\n                status, filepath = parts[0], parts[1]\\n                change_type = \\\"modified\\\"\\n                if \\\"A\\\" in status:\\n                    change_type = \\\"added\\\"\\n                elif \\\"D\\\" in status:\\n                    change_type = \\\"removed\\\"\\n                \\n                # Normalize filepath for forward slashes\\n                filepath_normalized = filepath.replace(\\\"\\\\\\\\\\\", \\\"/\\\")\\n                file_items.append({\\\"path\\\": filepath_normalized, \\\"change\\\": change_type})\\n                \\n                # Fetch before/after content for Diff blocks\\n                before_content = \\\"\\\"\\n                after_content = \\\"\\\"\\n                \\n                # If file exists, read it\\n                if os.path.exists(filepath):\\n                    with open(filepath, \\\"r\\\", encoding=\\\"utf-8\\\", errors=\\\"ignore\\\") as f:\\n                        after_content = f.read()\\n                        \\n                # Git show previous content\\n                git_ref = \\\"HEAD\\\" if not is_last_commit else \\\"HEAD~1\\\"\\n                rc_show, show_out, _ = self._git_run(f\\\"show {git_ref}:{filepath}\\\")\\n                if rc_show == 0:\\n                    before_content = show_out\\n                \\n                # Format code/diff blocks (escaping for MDX syntax)\\n                before_escaped = before_content.replace(\\\"\\\\\\`\\\", \\\"\\\\\\\\\\\\\\`\\\").replace(\\\"\\\\\\$\\\", \\\"\\\\\\\\\\\\\\$\\\")\\n                after_escaped = after_content.replace(\\\"\\\\\\`\\\", \\\"\\\\\\\\\\\\\\`\\\").replace(\\\"\\\\\\$\\\", \\\"\\\\\\\\\\\\\\$\\\")\\n                \\n                diff_blocks += f\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n<Diff \\n  id=\\\"diff-{diff_id}\\\" \\n  filename=\\\"{filepath_normalized}\\\" \\n  language=\\\"{filepath_normalized.split('.')[-1] if '.' in filepath_normalized else 'text'}\\\" \\n  before={{{json.dumps(before_escaped)}}}\\n  after={{{json.dumps(after_escaped)}}}\\n  summary=\\\"Code changes in {filepath_normalized}\\\" \\n/>\\n\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n                diff_id += 1\\n\\n        file_tree_json = json.dumps(file_items)\\n        \\n        mdx_content = f\\\"\\\"\\\"---\\ntitle: \\\"SeikoClaw Task Recap\\\"\\nbrief: \\\"Visual recap generated on completion of {task_id}\\\"\\nlocalOnly: true\\nkind: recap\\n---\\n\\n# SeikoClaw Task Recap\\n\\n## Changed Files\\n<FileTree items={file_tree_json} />\\n\\n## Code Walkthrough\\n{diff_blocks}\\n\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n        \\n        recap_mdx_path = os.path.join(recap_dir, \\\"plan.mdx\\\")\\n        with open(recap_mdx_path, \\\"w\\\", encoding=\\\"utf-8\\\") as f:\\n            f.write(mdx_content)\\n            \\n        npm_global_bin = \\\"/.npm-global/agent-native.cmd\\\"\\n        cmd_prefix = npm_global_bin if os.path.exists(npm_global_bin) else \\\"npx @agent-native/core\\\"\\n\\n        print(\\\"[SeikoClaw] Checking visual recap syntax...\\\")\\n        subprocess.run(f\\\"{cmd_prefix} plan local check --dir .agents/plans/recap\\\", shell=True)\\n        \\n        print(\\\"[SeikoClaw] Serving visual recap on local bridge...\\\")\\n        subprocess.Popen(f\\\"{cmd_prefix} plan local serve --dir .agents/plans/recap --kind recap --open\\\", shell=True)\\n        \\n        url_file = os.path.join(recap_dir, \\\".plan-url\\\")\\n        import time\\n        time.sleep(2)\\n        if os.path.exists(url_file):\\n            with open(url_file, \\\"r\\\", encoding=\\\"utf-8\\\") as f:\\n                url = f.read().strip()\\n            print(f\\\"[SUCCESS] Visual Recap served successfully!\\\\nLocal Bridge URL: {url}\\\")\\n            return url\\n        else:\\n            print(\\\"[INFO] Bridge starting. Open the local bridge URL from console logs.\\\")\\n            return None\\n\\ndef main():\\n    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=\\\"SeikoClaw Harness CLI\\\")\\n    parser.add_argument(\\\"action\\\", choices=[\\\"plan\\\", \\\"execute\\\", \\\"usage\\\", \\\"doctor\\\", \\\"sync-global\\\", \\\"memory\\\", \\\"reflect\\\", \\\"wiki-sync\\\", \\\"kanban\\\", \\\"loop\\\", \\\"recap\\\"])\\n    parser.add_argument(\\\"--task\\\", type=str)\\n    parser.add_argument(\\\"--status\\\", type=str)\\n    parser.add_argument(\\\"--goal\\\", type=str)\\n    parser.add_argument(\\\"--turns\\\", type=int, default=5)\\n    parser.add_argument(\\\"--command\\\", type=str, help=\\\"Command to run when executing a task\\\")\\n    parser.add_argument(\\\"--verify\\\", type=str, help=\\\"Verification command to run after executing a task\\\")\\n    parser.add_argument(\\\"--sandbox\\\", action=\\\"store_true\\\", help=\\\"Enable git-backed sandboxing for execution\\\")\\n    parser.add_argument(\\\"--query\\\", type=str, help=\\\"Search query for memory\\\")\\n    \\n    args = parser.parse_args()\\n    claw = SeikoClaw()\\n\\n    if args.action == \\\"plan\\\":\\n        task_file = args.task or \\\"task.md\\\"\\n        claw.generate_visual_plan(task_file)\\n    elif args.action == \\\"recap\\\":\\n = db_path\\n        self.chroma_path = chroma_path\\n        self.vault = Vault(db_path)\\n        self.usage = UsageMonitor(db_path)\\n        self.memory = MemoryEngine(db_path, chroma_path)\\n        self.gater = SkillGater()\\n        \\n        # Default limits\\n        self.limits = {\\n            \\\"anthropic\\\": {\\\"tokens\\\": 100000, \\\"requests\\\": 500},\\n            \\\"google\\\": {\\\"tokens\\\": 200000, \\\"requests\\\": 1000}\\n        }\\n\\n    def unlock_vault(self):\\n        print(\\\"[SeikoClaw] Initializing Vault...\\\")\\n        password = Some features will be locked.\\\")\\n            return False\\n        \\n        self.vault.unlock(password)\\n        return True\\n\\n    def _git_run(self, cmd):\\n        result = subprocess.run(f\\\"git {cmd}\\\", shell=True, capture_output=True, text=True, encoding=\\\"utf-8\\\", errors=\\\"replace\\\")\\n        stdout = (result.stdout or \\\"\\\").strip()\\n        stderr = (result.stderr or \\\"\\\").strip()\\n        return result.returncode, stdout, stderr\\n\\n    def _is_git_repo(self):\\n        rc, _, _ = self._git_run(\\\"rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree\\\")\\n        return rc == 0\\n\\n    def _get_current_branch(self):\\n        rc, out, _ = self._git_run(\\\"rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD\\\")\\n        if rc == 0:\\n            return out\\n        return None\\n\\n    def _is_git_dirty(self):\\n        rc, out, _ = self._git_run(\\\"status --porcelain\\\")\\n        return rc == 0 and bool(out)\\n\\n    def start_sandbox(self, task_id):\\n        if not self._is_git_repo():\\n            print(\\\"[SANDBOX WARNING] Not a Git repository.        print(f\\\"[SANDBOX ERROR] Failed to create sandbox branch: {err}\\\")\\n            if stashed:\\n                print(\\\"[SANDBOX] Restoring stashed changes...\\\")\\n  rc, _, err = self._git_run(f\\\"commit -m \\\\\\\"seikoclaw: completed task {task_id}\\\\\\\"\\\")\\n        if rc != 0:\\n            print(f\\\"[SANDBOX WARNING] Failed to commit changes (possibly print(f\\\"[SANDBOX ERROR] Merge failed: {err}\\\")\\n            return False\\n\\n        print(f\\\"[SANDBOX] Deleting sandbox branch {sandbox_branch}...\\\")\\n        self._git_run(f\\\"branch -d \\\"\\\"\\\"Orchestrates Tablebuddy Phase 11 testing.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n        print(\\\"[SeikoClaw] Starting Tablebuddy Backend...\\\")\\n        # Start server in background\\n        server =   finally:\\n            print(\\\"[SeikoClaw] Shutting down Tablebuddy Backend...\\\")\\n            server.terminate()\\n\\n    def execute_parallel(self, tasks, cwd=None):\\n in concurrent.futures.as_completed(fut_to_task):\\n                res = future.result()\\n                print(f\\\"[Completed] {res}\\\")\\n\\n    def sync_global(self):\\n        \\\"\\\"\\\"Syncs print(\\\"[SeikoClaw] Starting Global Sync...\\\")\\n        # 1. codecs.getwriter(\\\"utf-8\\\")(sys.stdout.detach())\\n\\nclass IterationBudget:\\n    def __init__(self, max_turns=5, max_tokens=100000, context_limit=1000000):\\n        self.max_turns = = db_path\\n        self.chroma_path = chroma_path\\n        self.vault = Vault(db_path)\\n        self.usage = UsageMonitor(db_path)\\n        self.memory = MemoryEngine(db_path, chroma_path)\\n        self.gater = SkillGater()\\n        self.graph = TaskGraph(db_path)\\n        self.gates = GateEngine(self.graph)\\n        self.watchdog = HealthPatrol(db_path=db_path)\\n        \\n        # password:\\n            print(\\\"[WARNING] SEIKOCLAW_MASTER_PASS env var not set. Some features will be locked.\\\")\\n            return False\\n        \\n        self.vault.unlock(password)\\n        return True\\n\\n    def _git_run(self, cmd):\\n        result = subprocess.run(f\\\"git {cmd}\\\", shell=True, capture_output=True, text=True, encoding=\\\"utf-8\\\", errors=\\\"replace\\\")\\n        stdout = (result.stdout or \\\"\\\").strip()\\n        stderr = (result.stderr or \\\"\\\").strip()\\n        return result.returncode, stdout, stderr\\n\\n    def _is_git_repo(self):\\n        rc, _, _ = self._git_run(\\\"rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree\\\")\\n        return rc == 0\\n\\n    def _get_current_branch(self):\\n        rc, out, _ = self._git_run(\\\"rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD\\\")\\n        if rc == 0:\\n            return out\\n        return None\\n\\n    def _is_git_dirty(self):\\n        rc, out, _ = self._git_run(\\\"status --porcelain\\\")\\n        return rc == 0 and bool(out)\\n\\n    def start_sandbox(self, task_id):\\n        if not self._is_git_repo():\\n            print(\\\"[SANDBOX WARNING] Not a Git repository. Stashing changes...\\\")\\n            rc, _, err = self._git_run(\\\"stash push -m \\\\\\\"seikoclaw-pre-sandbox-stash\\\\\\\"\\\")\\n            if rc != 0:\\n                print(f\\\"[SANDBOX print(f\\\"[SANDBOX] Creating and checking out sandbox branch: {sandbox_branch}\\\")\\n        \\n        rc, _, err = self._git_run(f\\\"checkout -b {sandbox_branch}\\\")\\n        if rc != 0:\\n            print(f\\\"[SANDBOX ERROR] Failed to create sandbox branch: {err}\\\")\\n            if stashed:\\n                print(\\\"[SANDBOX] Restoring stashed changes...\\\")\\n                self._git_run(\\\"stash pop\\\")\\n            return False, None, False\\n\\n        return True, original_branch, stashed\\n\\n    def commit_and_merge_sandbox(self, task_id, original_branch,  rc, _, err = self._git_run(f\\\"commit -m \\\\\\\"seikoclaw: completed task {task_id}\\\\\\\"\\\")\\n        if rc != 0:\\n            print(f\\\"[SANDBOX WARNING] Failed to commit changes (possibly no changes made): {err}\\\")\\n\\n        print(f\\\"[SANDBOX] Returning to original branch: {original_branch}\\\")\\n        rc, _, err = self._git_run(f\\\"checkout {original_branch}\\\")\\n        if rc != 0:\\n            print(f\\\"[SANDBOX ERROR] Failed to return to original branch: {err}\\\")\\n            return False\\n\\n        print(f\\\"[SANDBOX] Merging sandbox branch print(f\\\"[SANDBOX ERROR] Merge failed: {err}\\\")\\n            return False\\n\\n        print(f\\\"[SANDBOX] Deleting sandbox branch {sandbox_branch}...\\\")\\n        self._git_run(f\\\"branch -d {sandbox_branch}\\\")\\n\\n        if stashed:\\n            print(\\\"[SANDBOX] Restoring stashed changes...\\\")\\n            self._git_run(\\\"stash pop\\\")\\n\\n        return True\\n\\n    def {sandbox_branch}...\\\")\\n        \\n        self._git_run(\\\"reset --hard\\\")\\n        self._git_run(\\\"clean -fd\\\")\\n\\n        print(f\\\"[SANDBOX] Returning to original branch: {original_branch}\\\")\\n        rc, _, err = self._git_run(f\\\"checkout {original_branch}\\\")\\n        if rc != 0:\\n            print(f\\\"[SANDBOX ERROR] Failed to return to original branch: {err}\\\")\\n            return False\\n\\n        print(f\\\"[SANDBOX] Deleting sandbox branch {sandbox_branch}...\\\")\\n        self._git_run(f\\\"branch -D {sandbox_branch}\\\")\\n\\n        if stashed:\\n            print(\\\"[SANDBOX] Restoring stashed changes...\\\")\\n            self._git_run(\\\"stash pop\\\")\\n\\n        return True\\n\\n    def run_task(self, name, command,   # 1.       {\\\"name\\\": \\\"Auth & Roles\\\", \\\"command\\\": \\\"java -cp \\\\\\\"../karate.jar;.\\\\\\\" com.intuit.karate.Main api/auth_and_roles.feature\\\"},\\n                {\\\"name\\\": def execute_parallel(self, tasks, cwd=None):\\n        \\\"\\\"\\\"Runs multiple tasks in parallel using a thread pool.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n        print(f\\\"[SeikoClaw] Launching {len(tasks)} tasks in parallel...\\\")\\n        \\n        with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=4) as executor:\\n            fut_to_task = {executor.submit(self.run_task, t['name'], t['command'], cwd): sync_global(self):\\n        \\\"\\\"\\\"Syncs local .agents and third-party skills to global locations.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n        import shutil\\n        user_home = os.path.expanduser(\\\"~\\\")\\n        global_root = os.path.join(user_home, \\\".gemini\\\", \\\"antigravity\\\")\\n        \\n        mapping = {\\n            \\\".agents/workflows\\\": os.path.join(global_root, Sync Third-Party Agent Skills (Preserving directory structure)\\n        tp_skills_root = \\\"third-party/agent-skills/skills\\\"\\n        global_skills_dest = os.path.join(global_root, \\\"skills\\\", \\\"third-party\\\")\\n        if os.path.exists(tp_skills_root):\\n            print(\\\"[SeikoClaw] Syncing Third-Party Skills (Modular)...\\\")\\n            os.makedirs(global_skills_dest, exist_ok=True)\\n            for skill_name in os.listdir(tp_skills_root):\\n                skill_dir = os.path.join(tp_skills_root, skill_name)\\n                if os.path.isdir(skill_dir):\\n                    dest_dir = os.path.join(global_skills_dest, skill_name)\\n                    if os.path.exists(dest_dir):\\n                        shutil.rmtree(dest_dir)\\n                    shutil.copytree(skill_dir, dest_dir)\\n                    print(f\\\"[SYNCED-DIR] {skill_name} -> {global_skills_dest}\\\")\\n\\n    def reflect_on_task(self, task_file: str):\\n        \\\"\\\"\\\"Analyzes a task file and synthesizes or evolves a skill using pluggable LLM provider.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n        if not os.path.exists(task_file):\\n            return \\\"Error: Task file not found.\\\"\\n\\n        with open(task_file, \\\"r\\\", encoding=\\\"utf-8\\\") as f:\\n            content = f.read()\\n\\n        if \\\"[x]\\\" not in content:\\n            return \\\"No completed tasks found to reflect upon.\\\"\\n\\n        print(f\\\"[SeikoClaw] Reflecting on completed tasks in {os.path.basename(task_file)}...\\\")\\n        \\n        # 1. Synthesis via Pluggable LLM Provider\\n        try:\\n            llm = get_llm_provider()\\n            print(f\\\"[SeikoClaw] Using LLM Provider for reflection: {llm.name}\\\")\\n            \\n            import re\\n            skill_name_candidate = None\\n            match = re.search(r\\\"Skill:\\\\s*(.*)\\\", content)\\n            if match:\\n                skill_name_candidate = match.group(1).strip()\\n            \\n            previous_skill_text = \\\"None\\\"\\n            if skill_name_candidate:\\n                prev = self.memory.get_skill(skill_name_candidate)\\n                if prev:\\n                    previous_skill_text = str(prev)\\n            \\n            prompt = SKILL_SYNTHESIS_PROMPT.format(trajectory=content, previous_skill=previous_skill_text)\\n            skill_text = llm.generate(prompt, max_tokens=1024)\\n            \\n            if skill_text and \\\"[Mock Response]\\\" not in skill_text:\\n                # 2. Extract and Sanitize Skill Name\\n                name_match = re.search(r\\\"name:\\\\s*(.*)\\\", skill_text)\\n                raw_name = name_match.group(1).strip() if name_match else \\\"new-skill\\\"\\n                skill_name = re.sub(r\\\"[^\\\\w\\\\-]\\\", \\\"-\\\", raw_name.lower()).strip(\\\"-\\\") or \\\"new-skill\\\"\\n                \\n                # Ensure skill_text has the sanitized name\\n                skill_text = re.sub(r\\\"name:\\\\s*.*\\\", f\\\"name: {skill_name}\\\", skill_text, count=1)\\n                \\n                # 3. Gating check before saving (Validation & Regression)\\n                passed, gate_msg = self.gater.gate_and_save(\\n                    skill_text=skill_text,\\n                    skill_name=skill_name,\\n                    memory_engine=self.memory,\\n                    target_dir=\\\".agents/skills\\\",\\n                    previous_skill_text=previous_skill_text if previous_skill_text != \\\"None\\\" else None\\n                )\\n                \\n                if passed:\\n                    print(f\\\"[SUCCESS] { 'Evolved' if previous_skill_text != 'None' else 'Synthesized' } and gated skill: {skill_name}\\\")\\n                    self.sync_wiki(f\\\"Auto-evolved skill: {skill_name}\\\")\\n                    return skill_name\\n                else:\\n                    print(f\\\"[GATING FAILED] {gate_msg}\\\")\\n                    return None\\n        except Exception as e:\\n            print(f\\\"[ERROR] Skill reflection failed: {e}\\\")\\n            return None\\n\\n    def gate_skill(self, skill_target: str):\\n        \\\"\\\"\\\"Runs validation and regression tests against a skill file or registered skill.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n        print(f\\\"[SeikoClaw] Gating skill: {skill_target}...\\\")\\n        skill_text = \\\"\\\"\\n        if os.path.exists(skill_target):\\n            with open(skill_target, \\\"r\\\", encoding=\\\"utf-8\\\") as f:\\n                skill_text = f.read()\\n        else:\\n            # Check Openbrain\\n            skill_record = self.memory.get_skill(skill_target)\\n            if skill_record and skill_record.get(\\\"example\\\"):\\n                skill_text = skill_record[\\\"example\\\"]\\n            else:\\n                # Check .agents/skills/<skill_target>/SKILL.md\\n                candidate_path = os.path.join(\\\".agents\\\", \\\"skills\\\", skill_target, \\\"SKILL.md\\\")\\n                if os.path.exists(candidate_path):\\n                    with open(candidate_path, \\\"r\\\", encoding=\\\"utf-8\\\") as f:\\n                        skill_text = f.read()\\n\\n        if not skill_text:\\n            print(f\\\"[ERROR] Could not resolve skill content for: {skill_target}\\\")\\n            return False\\n\\n        passed, reason = self.gater.evaluate_regression(skill_text)\\n        if passed:\\n            print(f\\\"[GATE PASS] Skill '{skill_target}' passed all validation and regression checks.\\\")\\n            return True\\n        else:\\n            print(f\\\"[GATE FAIL] Skill '{skill_target}' failed gating:\\\\n  Reason: {reason}\\\")\\n            return False\\n\\n    def sync_wiki(self, message=\\\"Auto-sync from SeikoClaw\\\"):\\n        \\\"\\\"\\\"Syncs the current project state into the Master Wiki.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n        print(\\\"[SeikoClaw] Syncing state to Master Wiki...\\\")\\n        wiki_dir = os.getenv(\\\"SEIKOCLAW_WIKI_DIR\\\") or \\\"/.master_wiki\\\"\\n        if not os.path.exists(wiki_dir):\\n            for candidate in [\\\"../.master_wiki\\\", \\\"./.master_wiki\\\", os.path.join(os.path.expanduser(\\\"~\\\"), \\\".master_wiki\\\")]:\\n                if os.path.exists(candidate):\\n                    wiki_dir = candidate\\n                    break\\n\\n        if not os.path.exists(wiki_dir):\\n            print(f\\\"[INFO] Master Wiki not found at {wiki_dir}. Write directly to wiki directory\\n        print(\\\"[SeikoClaw] Writing progress to master wiki...\\\")\\n        try:\\n            target_page = os.path.join(wiki_dir, \\\"wiki\\\", \\\"synthesis\\\", \\\"latest_sync.md\\\")\\n            os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(target_page), exist_ok=True)\\n            with open(target_page, \\\"w\\\", encoding=\\\"utf-8\\\") as f:\\n                f.write(f\\\"# Latest Task Sync\\\\n\\\\nTags: auto-sync, seikoclaw\\\\n\\\\n## Recent Progress\\\\n\\\\n\\\\\\`\\\\\\`\\\\\\`markdown\\\\n{progress[:2000]}\\\\n\\\\\\`\\\\\\`\\\\\\`\\\\n\\\")\\n\\n            # 4. Auto-commit if wiki_dir is a git repo\\n            subprocess.run([\\\"git\\\", \\\"add\\\", \\\".\\\"], cwd=wiki_dir, shell=True, capture_output=True, timeout=10)\\n            subprocess.run([\\\"git\\\", \\\"commit\\\", \\\"-m\\\", f\\\"Auto-sync: {message}\\\"], cwd=wiki_dir, shell=True, capture_output=True, timeout=10)\\n            print(\\\"[SUCCESS] Master Wiki updated.\\\")\\n        except Exception as e:\\n            print(f\\\"[WARNING] Master Wiki sync encountered an issue: {e}\\\")\\n\\n    def manage_kanban(self, action, task_id=None, status=None, project=\\\"default\\\"):\\n        \\\"\\\"\\\"CLI helper for Kanban operations.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n        if action == \\\"list\\\":\\n            board = self.memory.get_kanban(project)\\n            print(f\\\"--- Kanban Board: {project} ---\\\")\\n            if not board:\\n                print(\\\"No tasks found.\\\")\\n            for tid, info in board.items():\\n                print(f\\\"[{info['status']}] {tid} (Updated: {info['updated_at']})\\\")\\n        elif action == \\\"update\\\" and task_id and status:\\n            self.memory.update_kanban(project, task_id, status)\\n            print(f\\\"[SUCCESS] Updated {task_id} to {status}\\\")\\n\\n    def loop_until_goal(self, goal, max_turns=5, mode=\\\"simulate\\\", worker_id=\\\"loop-worker\\\"):\\n        \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n        Autonomous loop for SeikoClaw.\\n        - 'simulate': Context estimation & handoff benchmark loop.\\n        - 'dag': Live DAG task pump that claims and executes ready frontier tasks.\\n        \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n        budget = IterationBudget(max_turns=max_turns)\\n        print(f\\\"[SeikoClaw] Starting autonomous loop (mode={mode}) for goal: {goal}\\\")\\n        \\n        while not budget.is_exhausted():\\n            print(f\\\"\\\\n--- Turn {budget.current_turns + 1} ---\\\")\\n            \\n            # 1. Estimate current context\\n            memories = self.memory.retrieve_similar(goal, n_results=20)\\n            context_text = \\\"\\\\n\\\".join([m['content'] for m in memories])\\n            current_context_tokens = token_estimator.estimate_tokens(context_text)\\n            \\n            budget.consume(tokens=0, context_tokens=current_context_tokens)\\n            print(f\\\"[STATUS] {budget}\\\")\\n            \\n            # 2. Watchdog Health & Circuit-Breaker Check\\n            health = self.watchdog.get_health_status(current_tokens=current_context_tokens)\\n            if health.get(\\\"is_spinning\\\"):\\n                spin_msg = health.get(\\\"spin_reason\\\")\\n                print(f\\\"[CIRCUIT BREAKER] {spin_msg}\\\")\\n                self.memory.save_mistake(\\n                    task_id=f\\\"loop-stall-turn-{budget.current_turns}\\\",\\n                    error_trace=spin_msg,\\n                    context=f\\\"Autonomous loop for goal: {goal}\\\",\\n                    hypothesis=\\\"Execution halted by watchdog circuit breaker. Resolve repetitive failures.\\\"\\n                )\\n                break\\n\\n            # 3. Check for context ceiling / auto-handoff\\n            if current_context_tokens >= (budget.context_limit * 0.9):\\n                print(f\\\"[CRITICAL] Context limit reached ({current_context_tokens} tokens).\\\")\\n                print(\\\"[ACTION] Performing auto-handoff...\\\")\\n                handoff_path = \\\"handoff.md\\\"\\n                with open(handoff_path, \\\"w\\\", encoding=\\\"utf-8\\\") as f:\\n                    f.write(f\\\"# Handoff: {goal}\\\\n\\\\nLoop paused due to context pressure.\\\\n\\\")\\n                    f.write(f\\\"Tokens: {current_context_tokens}\\\\n\\\")\\n                    f.write(f\\\"Last Action: Loop Turn {budget.current_turns}\\\\n\\\")\\n                print(f\\\"[ALERT] Handoff created at {handoff_path}. Please start a new session.\\\")\\n                break\\n\\n            # 4. Mode Execution\\n            if mode == \\\"dag\\\":\\n                # Active DAG task pump\\n                claimed = self.graph.claim_next_ready(worker_id=worker_id, filter_gates=True)\\n                if not claimed:\\n                    # Check if tasks are blocked\\n                    remaining = self.graph.list_tasks(status=\\\"open\\\")\\n                    if remaining:\\n                        print(f\\\"[INFO] DAG pump complete: {len(remaining)} open tasks remain, but all are blocked by dependencies or pending gates.\\\")\\n                    else:\\n                        print(\\\"[SUCCESS] All open DAG tasks completed!\\\")\\n                    break\\n\\n                task_id = claimed[\\\"id\\\"]\\n                task_title = claimed[\\\"title\\\"]\\n                meta = claimed.get(\\\"gate_metadata\\\", {})\\n                cmd = meta.get(\\\"command\\\") or f\\\"echo 'Executing DAG task {task_id}: {task_title}'\\\"\\n                \\n                print(f\\\"[DAG ACTION] Claimed: {task_id} - {task_title}\\\")\\n                res = self.run_task(task_title, cmd)\\n                if \\\"SUCCESS\\\" in res:\\n                    # Update status to closed\\n                    self.graph.close_task(task_id)\\n                    print(f\\\"[DAG SUCCESS] Task {task_id} marked as closed.\\\")\\n                else:\\n                    self.graph.update_status(task_id, \\\"open\\\")\\n                    print(f\\\"[DAG RETRY] Task {task_id} command failed; returned to open pool.\\\")\\n            else:\\n                # Post-Task Reflection Hook: Trigger auto-reflection if task.md exists\\n        for p in [\\\"task.md\\\", \\\"artifact/task.md\\\"]:\\n            if os.path.exists(p):\\n                print(\\\"[AUTO-HOOK] Triggering Post-Task Reflection Hook...\\\")\\n                self.reflect_on_task(p)\\n                self.sync_wiki(f\\\"Auto-sync after loop for goal: {goal}\\\")\\n                break\\n\\n    def show_ready_frontier(self, claim=False, worker_id=\\\"executor-1\\\", as_json=False):\\n        \\\"\\\"\\\"Displays or atomically claims the ready frontier from the Task DAG.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n        if claim:\\n            claimed = self.graph.claim_next_ready(worker_id=worker_id, filter_gates=True)\\n            if claimed:\\n                if as_json:\\n                    print(json.dumps(claimed, indent=2))\\n                else:\\n                    gate_info = f\\\" [GATE: {claimed['gate_type'].upper()}]\\\" if claimed.get('gate_type') else \\\"\\\"\\n                    print(f\\\"[CLAIMED] Worker '{worker_id}' successfully claimed: {claimed['id']} - {claimed['title']}{gate_info}\\\")\\n            else:\\n                if as_json:\\n                    print(json.dumps({\\\"status\\\": \\\"empty\\\", \\\"message\\\": \\\"No ready tasks available on frontier.\\\"}))\\n                else:\\n                    print(\\\"[INFO] No ready tasks available on the frontier.\\\")\\n            return claimed\\n\\n        # All tasks are closed or waiting on blockers/gates.\\\")\\n            for t in claimable:\\n                wisp = \\\" [WISP]\\\" if t.get('is_ephemeral') else \\\"\\\"\\n                print(f\\\"- {t['id']}: {t['title']} (P{t['priority']}){wisp}\\\")\\n\\n            if gated:\\n                print(\\\"\\\\n=== \\ud83d\\udea7 Tasks Awaiting Gate Certification ===\\\")\\n                for t in gated:\\n                    print(f\\\"- {t['id']}: {t['title']} (P{t['priority']}) [GATE: {t['gate_type'].upper()} - PENDING]\\\")\\n        return all_frontier\\n\\n    def show_health_status(self):\\n        \\\"\\\"\\\"Displays health patrol diagnostics and watchdog recommendations.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n        status = self.watchdog.get_health_status()\\n        print(\\\"=== \\ud83d\\udee1\\ufe0f SeikoClaw Health Patrol Status ===\\\")\\n        print(f\\\"Status: {status['status']}\\\")\\n        print(f\\\"Is Spinning: {status['is_spinning']}\\\")\\n        if status.get('spin_reason'):\\n            print(f\\\"Alert: {status['spin_reason']}\\\")\\n        print(f\\\"Context Utilization: {status['context_utilization']*100:.1f}%\\\")\\n        print(f\\\"Total Tracked Actions: {status['total_actions']}\\\")\\n        if status['recommendations']:\\n            print(\\\"Recommendations:\\\")\\n            for rec in status['recommendations']:\\n                print(f\\\"  * {rec}\\\")\\n        return status\\n\\n    def generate_visual_plan(self, task_file=\\\"task.md\\\"):\\n        \\\"\\\"\\\"Generates a visual plan from a task file or master vision and serves the local bridge.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n        import re\\n        import json\\n        print(f\\\"[SeikoClaw] Generating Visual Plan from {task_file}...\\\")\\n        \\n        # 1. Resolve content\\n        content = \\\"\\\"\\n        if os.path.exists(task_file):\\n            with open(task_file, \\\"r\\\", encoding=\\\"utf-8\\\") as f:\\n                content = f.read()\\n        else:\\n            # Fallback to project_vision.md\\n            vision_path = \\\"project_vision.md\\\"\\n            if os.path.exists(vision_path):\\n                with open(vision_path, \\\"r\\\", encoding=\\\"utf-8\\\") as f:\\n                    content = f.read()\\n            else:\\n                content = \\\"No task file found.\\\"\\n\\n        # 2. Setup directory\\n        plan_dir = os.path.join(\\\".agents\\\", \\\"plans\\\", \\\"plan\\\")\\n        os.makedirs(plan_dir, exist_ok=True)\\n        \\n        # 3. Write plan.mdx\\n        header_text = (\\n            \\\"---\\\\n\\\"\\n            'title: \\\"SeikoClaw Visual Plan\\\"\\\\n'\\n            'brief: \\\"Visual plan generated for task planning\\\"\\\\n'\\n            \\\"localOnly: true\\\\n\\\"\\n            \\\"---\\\\n\\\\n\\\"\\n            \\\"# SeikoClaw Task Plan\\\\n\\\\n\\\"\\n            \\\"## Task Description\\\\n\\\"\\n            f\\\"{content}\\\\n\\\\n\\\"\\n            \\\"<Checklist id=\\\\\\\"seikoclaw-checklist\\\\\\\" items={[\\\\n\\\"\\n        )\\n        mdx_content = header_text\\n        # Convert checklist lines\\n        item_id = 1\\n        for line in content.splitlines():\\n            # Match task checklist item\\n            m = re.match(r\\\"^\\\\s*-\\\\s*\\\\[\\\\s*\\\\]\\\\s*(.*)\\\", line)\\n            if m:\\n                label = m.group(1).replace('\\\"', '\\\\\\\\\\\"').strip()\\n                mdx_content += f'  {{ id: \\\"task-{item_id}\\\", label: \\\"{label}\\\" }},\\\\n'\\n                item_id += 1\\n        \\n        mdx_content += \\\"]}\\\\n/>\\\\n\\\"\\n        \\n        plan_mdx_path = os.path.join(plan_dir, \\\"plan.mdx\\\")\\n        with open(plan_mdx_path, \\\"w\\\", encoding=\\\"utf-8\\\") as f:\\n            f.write(mdx_content)\\n        \\n        # 4. Serve the bridge\\n        agent_native_env = os.getenv(\\\"AGENT_NATIVE_CMD\\\")\\n        if agent_native_env and os.path.exists(agent_native_env):\\n            cmd_prefix = agent_native_env\\n        else:\\n            cmd_prefix = shutil.which(\\\"agent-native\\\") or \\\"npx @agent-native/core\\\"\\n\\n        print(\\\"[SeikoClaw] Checking visual plan syntax...\\\")\\n        subprocess.run(f\\\"{cmd_prefix} plan local check --dir .agents/plans/plan\\\", shell=True)\\n        \\n        print(\\\"[SeikoClaw] Serving visual plan on local bridge...\\\")\\n        # Start server in background so CLI execution doesn't block permanently\\n        subprocess.Popen(f\\\"{cmd_prefix} plan local serve --dir .agents/plans/plan --kind plan --open\\\", shell=True)\\n        \\n        # Read the URL\\n        url_file = os.path.join(plan_dir, \\\".plan-url\\\")\\n        import time\\n        time.sleep(2)\\n        if os.path.exists(url_file):\\n            with open(url_file, \\\"r\\\", encoding=\\\"utf-8\\\") as f:\\n                url = f.read().strip()\\n            print(f\\\"[SUCCESS] Visual Plan served successfully!\\\\nLocal Bridge URL: {url}\\\")\\n        else:\\n            print(\\\"[INFO] Bridge starting.           after_escaped = after_content.replace(\\\"\\\\\\`\\\", \\\"\\\\\\\\\\\\\\`\\\").replace(\\\"\\\\\\$\\\", \\\"\\\\\\\\\\\\\\$\\\")\\n                \\n                diff_blocks += f\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n<Diff \\n  id=\\\"diff-{diff_id}\\\" \\n  filename=\\\"{filepath_normalized}\\\" \\n  language=\\\"{filepath_normalized.split('.')[-1] if '.' in filepath_normalized else 'text'}\\\" \\n  before={{{json.dumps(before_escaped)}}}\\n  after={{{json.dumps(after_escaped)}}}\\n  summary=\\\"Code changes in {filepath_normalized}\\\" \\n/>\\n\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n                diff_id +=      \\n        recap_mdx_path = os.path.join(recap_dir, \\\"plan.mdx\\\")\\n        with open(recap_mdx_path, \\\"w\\\", encoding=\\\"utf-8\\\") as f:\\n            f.write(mdx_content)\\n   after={"import os\nimport sys\nimport json\nfrom datetime import datetime\n\n# Add local path to sys.path to allow importing openbrain\nsys.path.append(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))\n\nfrom openbrain.memory_engine import MemoryEngine\nfrom openbrain.usage_monitor import UsageMonitor\n\nclass AutoCapture:\n    def __init__(self):\n        # Resolve DB path local-first with global fallback\n        cwd_openbrain = os.path.join(os.getcwd(), \"openbrain\")\n        if os.path.isdir(cwd_openbrain):\n            db_path = os.path.join(cwd_openbrain, \"openbrain.db\")\n            chroma_path = os.path.join(cwd_openbrain, \"chroma_db\")\n        else:\n            global_dir = os.path.join(os.path.expanduser(\"~\"), \".gemini\", \"antigravity\", \"openbrain\")\n            os.makedirs(global_dir, exist_ok=True)\n            db_path = os.path.join(global_dir, \"openbrain.db\")\n            chroma_path = os.path.join(global_dir, \"chroma_db\")\n            \n        print(f\"[AutoCapture] Using Database: {db_path}\")\n        self.memory = MemoryEngine(db_path, chroma_path)\n        self.usage = UsageMonitor(db_path)\n\n    def find_recent_task_md(self):\n        # 1. Check local directory first\n        for p in [\"task.md\", \"artifact/task.md\"]:\n            if os.path.exists(p):\n                return p\n        # 2. Check global brain folders for the most recently modified task.md\n        brain_dir = os.path.join(os.path.expanduser(\"~\"), \".gemini\", \"antigravity\", \"brain\")\n        if os.path.exists(brain_dir):\n            task_files = []\n            for root, dirs, files in os.walk(brain_dir):\n                if \"task.md\" in files:\n                    p = os.path.join(root, \"task.md\")\n                    try:\n                        mtime = os.path.getmtime(p)\n                        task_files.append((p, mtime))\n                    except Exception:\n                        pass\n            if task_files:\n                task_files.sort(key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)\n                return task_files[0][0]\n        return None\n\n    def capture_session(self):\n        print(\"[AutoCapture] Evaluating session state...\")\n        \n        # 1. Read task.md for progress\n        progress = \"No recent task info found.\"\n        task_md_path = self.find_recent_task_md()\n        if task_md_path and os.path.exists(task_md_path):\n            print(f\"[AutoCapture] Reading tasks from: {task_md_path}\")\n            with open(task_md_path, \"r\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n                progress = f.read()\n        \n        # 2. Get Usage Metrics\n        google_usage = self.usage.get_todays_usage(\"google\")\n        usage_str = f\"Usage today: {google_usage['tokens']} tokens.\"\n        \n        # 3. Summarize\n        project_name = os.path.basename(os.getcwd())\n        summary = f\"Session Capture ({project_name}): Successfully completed tasks. {usage_str} Progress:\\n{progress[:2000]}\"\n        \n        # 4. Save to memory\n        mem_id = self.memory.save_memory(summary, tier=\"Shortterm\", source=\"auto-capture\")\n        print(f\"[AutoCapture] Saved session summary: {mem_id}\")\n        \n        # 5. Mistake Capture & Automated Reflection\n        try:\n            from seikoclaw import SeikoClaw\n            claw = SeikoClaw()\n\n            # Record capture action to watchdog\n            claw.watchdog.record_action(\"auto_capture\", project_name, summary[:100], success=True)\n\n            # A. Check for blockers / mistakes\n            if \"[BLOCKED]\" in progress or \"Error\" in progress or \"FAILURE\" in progress:\n                print(\"[AutoCapture] Detected task blockers/errors. Persisting mistake record...\")\n                self.memory.save_mistake(\n                    task_id=f\"{project_name}-task-blocker\",\n                    error_trace=progress[:1500],\n                    context=f\"Session capture in {project_name}\",\n                    hypothesis=\"Review blockers in task.md before re-attempting.\"\n                )\n                claw.watchdog.record_action(\"task_error\", project_name, progress[:100], success=False)\n\n            # B. Automated Post-Task Reflection Hook\n            if task_md_path and \"[x]\" in progress and \"- [ ]\" not in progress:\n                print(\"[AutoCapture] All tasks marked complete. Triggering automated skill reflection...\")\n                evolved_skill = claw.reflect_on_task(task_md_path)\n                if evolved_skill:\n                    print(f\"[AutoCapture] Successfully evolved/gated skill: {evolved_skill}\")\n                claw.sync_wiki(f\"Auto-sync on task completion for {project_name}\")\n            else:\n                # Midterm skill note\n                skill_text = f\"Task state in {project_name}: {progress.count('[x]')} completed steps.\"\n                self.memory.save_memory(skill_text, tier=\"Midterm\", source=\"auto-capture\", tags=\"skill,progress\")\n        except Exception as e:\n            print(f\"[AutoCapture Warning] Reflection hook encountered an issue: {e}\")\n\n        # 6. Trigger Visual Recap\n        try:\n            from seikoclaw import SeikoClaw\n            claw = SeikoClaw()\n            recap_url = claw.generate_visual_recap(project_name)\n            if recap_url:\n                self.memory.save_memory(f\"Visual Recap URL: {recap_url}\", tier=\"Shortterm\", source=\"auto-capture\", tags=\"recap,visual\")\n                print(f\"[AutoCapture] Saved Visual Recap URL to Openbrain: {recap_url}\")\n        except Exception as e:\n            print(f\"[AutoCapture Warning] Visual recap generation failed: {e}\")\n\ndef main():\n    ac = AutoCapture()\n    ac.capture_session()\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    main()\n"}

  before={"import sqlite3\nimport base64\nimport os\nfrom cryptography.hazmat.primitives import hashes\nfrom cryptography.hazmat.primitives.kdf.pbkdf2 import PBKDF2HMAC\nfrom cryptography.hazmat.primitives.ciphers.aead import AESGCM\nfrom cryptography.exceptions import InvalidTag\n\nclass Vault:\n    def __init__(self, db_path=\"openbrain.db\"):\n        self.db_path = db_path\n        self._key = None\n\n    def unlock(self, master_password: str):\n        \"\"\"Derives the encryption key from the master password and a salt from the DB.\"\"\"\n        # If no salt exists, this is a 'first time' setup\n        conn = sqlite3.connect(self.db_path)\n        cur = conn.cursor()\n        cur.execute(\"SELECT salt FROM secrets_vault LIMIT 1\")\n        row = cur.fetchone()\n        \n        if row:\n            salt = base64.b64decode(row[0])\n        else:\n            # First time initialization\n            salt = os.urandom(16)\n        \n        kdf = PBKDF2HMAC(\n            algorithm=hashes.SHA256(),\n            length=32,\n            salt=salt,\n            iterations=100000,\n        )\n        self._key = kdf.derive(master_password.encode())\n        self._salt = salt\n        conn.close()\n        return True\n\n    def set_secret(self, key_name: str, value: str):\n        if not self._key:\n            raise Exception(\"Vault is locked. Call unlock() first.\")\n        \n        aesgcm = AESGCM(self._key)\n        nonce = os.urandom(12)\n        ciphertext = aesgcm.encrypt(nonce, value.encode(), None)\n        \n        # Combine nonce + ciphertext\n        encrypted_blob = base64.b64encode(nonce + ciphertext).decode()\n        salt_encoded = base64.b64encode(self._salt).decode()\n        \n        conn = sqlite3.connect(self.db_path)\n        cur = conn.cursor()\n        cur.execute(\"\"\"\n            INSERT OR REPLACE INTO secrets_vault (secret_key, encrypted_value, salt)\n            VALUES (?, ?, ?)\n        \"\"\", (key_name, encrypted_blob, salt_encoded))\n        conn.commit()\n        conn.close()\n\n    def get_secret(self, key_name: str):\n        if not self._key:\n            raise Exception(\"Vault is locked.   after={"import sqlite3\nimport base64\nimport os\nfrom cryptography.hazmat.primitives import hashes\nfrom cryptography.hazmat.primitives.kdf.pbkdf2 import PBKDF2HMAC\nfrom cryptography.hazmat.primitives.ciphers.aead import AESGCM\nfrom cryptography.exceptions import InvalidTag\n\nclass Vault:\n    def __init__(self, db_path=\"openbrain.db\"):\n        self.db_path = db_path\n        self._key = None\n        self._salt = None\n        self._ensure_table()\n\n    def _ensure_table(self):\n        \"\"\"Creates the secrets_vault table if it does not exist.\"\"\"\n        conn = sqlite3.connect(self.db_path)\n        cur = conn.cursor()\n        cur.execute(\"\"\"\n            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS secrets_vault (\n                secret_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n                encrypted_value TEXT NOT NULL,\n                salt TEXT NOT NULL,\n                updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n            )\n        \"\"\")\n        conn.commit()\n        conn.close()\n\n    def unlock(self, master_password: str):\n        \"\"\"Derives the encryption key from the master password and a salt from the DB.\"\"\"\n        self._ensure_table()\n        conn = sqlite3.connect(self.db_path)\n        cur = conn.cursor()\n        cur.execute(\"SELECT salt FROM secrets_vault LIMIT 1\")\n        row = cur.fetchone()\n        \n        if row:\n            salt = base64.b64decode(row[0])\n        else:\n            # First time initialization\n            salt = os.urandom(16)\n        \n        kdf = PBKDF2HMAC(\n            algorithm=hashes.SHA256(),\n            length=32,\n            salt=salt,\n            iterations=100000,\n        )\n        self._key = kdf.derive(master_password.encode())\n        self._salt = salt\n        conn.close()\n        return True\n\n    def set_secret(self, key_name: str, value: str):\n        if not self._key:\n            raise Exception(\"Vault is locked. Call unlock() first.\")\n        \n        aesgcm = AESGCM(self._key)\n        nonce = os.urandom(12)\n        ciphertext = aesgcm.encrypt(nonce, value.encode(), None)\n        \n        # Combine nonce + ciphertext\n        encrypted_blob = base64.b64encode(nonce + ciphertext).decode()\n        salt_encoded = base64.b64encode(self._salt).decode()\n        \n        conn = sqlite3.connect(self.db_path)\n        cur = conn.cursor()\n        cur.execute(\"\"\"\n            INSERT OR REPLACE INTO secrets_vault (secret_key, encrypted_value, salt)\n            VALUES (?, ?, ?)\n        \"\"\", (key_name, encrypted_blob, salt_encoded))\n        conn.commit()\n        conn.close()\n\n    def get_secret(self, key_name: str):\n        if not self._key:\n            raise Exception(\"Vault is locked. Call unlock() first.\")\n        \n        conn = sqlite3.connect(self.db_path)\n        cur = conn.cursor()\n        cur.execute(\"SELECT encrypted_value FROM secrets_vault WHERE secret_key = ?\", (key_name,))\n        row = cur.fetchone()\n        conn.close()\n        \n        if not row:\n            return None\n            \n        blob = base64.b64decode(row[0])\n        nonce = blob[:12]\n        ciphertext = blob[12:]\n        \n        aesgcm = AESGCM(self._key)\n        try:\n            decrypted = aesgcm.decrypt(nonce, ciphertext, None)\n            return decrypted.decode()\n        except InvalidTag:\n            raise Exception(\"Failed to decrypt secret. Incorrect master password?\")\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    # Test\n    v = Vault(\"openbrain.db\")\n    pw = \"test_pass\"\n    v.unlock(pw)\n    v.set_secret(\"OPENAI_KEY\", \"sk-12345\")\n    print(f\"Decrypted: {v.get_secret('OPENAI_KEY')}\")\n"}

  before={"import hashlib\nimport time\nfrom typing import List, Dict, Any, Optional, Tuple\n\nclass HealthPatrol:\n    \"\"\"\n    Autonomous Watchdog & Health Patrol for SeikoClaw loops.\n    Detects loop spin, repetitive failures, command stalls, and context ceiling limits.\n    \"\"\"\n    def __init__(self, spin_threshold: int = 3, context_limit: int = 1000000, ceiling_ratio: float = 0.85):\n        self.spin_threshold = spin_threshold\n        self.context_limit = context_limit\n        self.ceiling_ratio = ceiling_ratio\n        self.action_history: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []\n        self.stall_events: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []\n\n    def record_action(self, action_type: str, target: str, result_snippet: str = \"\", success: bool = True):\n        \"\"\"\n        Records an action signature into health patrol buffer.\n        \"\"\"\n        raw = f\"{action_type}:{target}:{result_snippet[:200]}\"\n        sig = hashlib.sha256(raw.encode('utf-8')).hexdigest()[:12]\n        \n        entry = {\n            \"action_type\": action_type,\n            \"target\": target,\n            \"signature\": sig,\n            \"success\": success,\n            \"timestamp\": time.time()\n        }\n        self.action_history.append(entry)\n\n    def check_spin(self) -> Tuple[bool, Optional[str]]:\n        \"\"\"\n        Checks if the last N actions have identical signatures or failure loops.\n        \"\"\"\n        if len(self.action_history) < self.spin_threshold:\n            return False, None\n\n        recent = self.action_history[-self.spin_threshold:]\n        first_sig = recent[0][\"signature\"]\n        all_same = all(a[\"signature\"] == first_sig for a in recent)\n        \n        if all_same:\n            action_desc = f\"{recent[0]['action_type']} on {recent[0]['target']}\"\n            return True, f\"Agent spin detected: Repeated identical action {self.spin_threshold} times ({action_desc}).\"\n\n        # Check consecutive failures\n        all_failed = all(not a[\"success\"] for a in recent)\n        if all_failed:\n            return True, f\"Consecutive failure stall: {self.spin_threshold} actions failed in succession.\"\n\n        return False, None\n\n    def check_context_ceiling(self, current_tokens: int) -> Tuple[bool, float]:\n        \"\"\"\n        Checks if context tokens exceed the ceiling ratio (default 85%).\n        \"\"\"\n        ratio = current_tokens / max(self.context_limit, 1)\n        is_breached = ratio >= self.ceiling_ratio\n        return is_breached, ratio\n\n    def get_health_status(self, current_tokens: int = 0) -> Dict[str, Any]:\n        is_spinning, spin_msg = self.check_spin()\n        ceiling_breached, ratio = self.check_context_ceiling(current_tokens)\n        \n        status = \"HEALTHY\"\n        recommendations = []\n\n        if is_spinning:\n            status = \"STALLED\"\n            recommendations.append(\"Trigger circuit-breaker: interrupt current execution, query OpenBrain for past mistakes, or summon Seikojin QA Strategist.\")\n\n        if ceiling_breached:\n            status = \"CONTEXT_CEILING\" if status == \"HEALTHY\" else \"CRITICAL\"\n            recommendations.append(f\"Context utilization at {ratio*100:.1f}%. Trigger automatic memory checkpoint and re-prime next frontier task.\")\n\n        return {\n            \"status\": status,\n            \"is_spinning\": is_spinning,\n            \"spin_reason\": spin_msg,\n            \"context_utilization\": ratio,\n            \"ceiling_breached\": ceiling_breached,\n            \"total_actions\": len(self.action_history),\n            \"recommendations\": recommendations\n        }"}
